verdict.rationale: The evidence shows vLLM exposes some low-level overrides. These include `linear_backend_per_quant` to override the quantization backend per scheme, `--torch-backend` selection at install, `--trust-remote-code`, and registering custom out-of-tree quantization methods. Together these suggest a configurable rather than opinionated engine, but nothing addresses memory locking or mmap behavior specifically. Missing for 10: documented mlock/mmap or memory-loading controls, a broad reference of engine-level configuration flags, and hands-on corroboration of overriding defaults.
